ConnectionStrings._Redis_comment: Matches the port docker-compose publishes for the redis service. An empty value here silently selects the development in-memory cache, which means the documented 'dotnet run' workflow never exercises DistributedCacheService at all - so start redis before running the API. See backend/README.md.

Auth._comment: Raised for local testing: walking the acceptance checklist makes many auth calls from one address. Production keeps the stricter default in appsettings.json.
